purpose: Semantic fixtures for AME's first course-quality learner and agent stories.

identity.production_rule: Fixtures must not require a specific learner email; local bootstrap may enroll the named demo learner.

journeys.title: Apache Flink foundations and Kubernetes operations
journeys.intent: I want to learn Apache Flink fundamentals, including streams, state, windows, and how Flink jobs run on Kubernetes.

learner_profile.desired_outcome: Understand the core runtime model, reason about event-time processing, and explain how to run a reliable Flink job on Kubernetes.

chapters.title: Streams, events, and time
objectives: Distinguish processing time, ingestion time, and event time.

chapters.title: State, consistency, and recovery
objectives: Explain keyed state and operator state.
Describe checkpoints and their role in recovery.

chapters.title: Windows, watermarks, and late data
objectives: Choose a windowing strategy for a stream requirement.
Explain how watermarks and allowed lateness affect results.

chapters.title: Job execution and the Flink Kubernetes Operator
objectives: Describe the roles of JobManager, TaskManagers, and task slots.
Explain the deployment lifecycle of a Flink job on Kubernetes.

journeys.title: Database indexing foundations
journeys.intent: I want to understand how database indexes work and choose an index for a query workload.

learner_profile.desired_outcome: Read a query plan, explain index tradeoffs, and propose an index with evidence.

chapters.title: What an index provides
objectives: Explain how an index changes data access.
Distinguish lookup cost from write and storage cost.

chapters.title: Designing and validating an index
objectives: Choose an index for a concrete query workload.
Validate the choice using a query plan and measurements.

story_assertions.journey_structure: Every journey has ordered chapters, objectives, instructional activities, assessment or task activities, and a next-action policy.
story_assertions.learner_boundary: All journey, content, attempt, evidence, and recommendation reads and writes resolve to the authenticated learner subject.
story_assertions.content_boundary: Every rendered capability has a typed payload and a version or provenance reference.
story_assertions.progress_boundary: Only completed or reviewed learner work can create evidence; generated content alone is never evidence.
story_assertions.resume_boundary: Refreshing, restarting, or changing authorized clients preserves the same journey and active activity state.
